excluded_samples.reason: Singleton lineage cannot occur in both disjoint sets.

target: Unchanged negative harmonized CTRP erastin AUC. Higher means more sensitive. No culture predictors.
split_design: 20 response-blind lineage-stratified identity-group holdouts. Approximately 80/20 per lineage, nearest feasible rounded sample count, at least one identity group on each side. Uniform random group subsets conditional on each sample-count target.
inner_design: Five identity-group-stratified validation folds within outer training. A lineage represented by one training identity group is always inner training (-2) and never inner validation. Thus all 23 lineages remain in every inner training set; validation has 22 lineages because Ampulla has only one outer-training line.
ampulla_handling: Two total lines: one outer train and one outer test in every repeat. Outer-training Ampulla is present in every inner fit but not inner validation; outer test is never used for tuning.

neural_fixed.prediction: average of three independently initialized networks in inner and outer fits
neural_fixed.scaling: StandardScaler for X and y fit only on the current training subset

weighting: Unweighted; equal-mean five-fold RMSE in original response units; first fixed grid candidate breaks ties.
preprocessing: Every StandardScaler fits only the current inner training set, or outer training at selected refit. No feature filtering based on response or all-cohort variance; no culture/lineage/identity predictors.
selection: Full Hallmark EMT (200) and DNA repair (150) sets selected by user before these fits. Include all mapped genes; no data-driven gene selection outside Elastic Net training. Preserve 64-gene order, append additions, deduplicate stable Entrez IDs. GPX4 is already in the 64-gene panel. BOLA2/BOLA2B header collision resolved by exact symbol and release HGNC, retaining BOLA2 only.
source_sets: Official MSigDB snapshots downloaded 2026-11-02; JSON membership and HTML stable NCBI identifiers independently agree. Sets are expression programs, not exhaustive functional catalogues. BRCA1/BRCA2/ZEB1/ZEB2 not added as unselected extras.

uncertainty.unit: Paired whole-lineage bootstrap shared across models and all 20 split-specific test sets; conditional on predictions, no refitting, no multiplicity adjustment. Repeated test sets overlap and are not independent biological replicates. These conditional intervals also do not adjust for the prior five-gene selection.

limitations: Exploratory reuse of the cell-line cohort; evaluates new cell lines from represented lineages, not unseen-lineage transfer. No external validation. Rare-lineage test subsets are tiny; one Ampulla training line cannot be an inner validation point. Panel/model comparisons reuse this cohort after earlier exploration; no multiplicity adjustment or independent external validation.

Earlier test responses influenced the choice of this five-gene panel. Reusing the same outer splits gives an exploratory post-selection comparison, not independent validation of feature selection. Inner hyperparameter tuning does not remove this selection bias; a fresh response cohort or prospectively reserved test set is required for confirmatory validation.
Hallmark membership fixed independently of these fits, but this cell-line cohort has informed earlier modelling choices; overlapping holdouts are exploratory, not independent external validation.
Expression of repair/EMT genes does not establish functional repair deficiency or an EMT state; EMT interpretation in hematologic lineages is especially limited.
Erastin system-xc inhibition and GPX4-inhibitor sensitivity are different targets; mechanistic literature is a rationale, not a guarantee of predictive gain.
The exact upstream harmonized CTRP AUC generation recipe remains unverified.
